breakdown.description: The specified outer-boundary point load is replaced by a distributed end traction
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to replace the point load with a distributed traction. The ground truth corrected this, stating to use a `PointSource`. The agent's generated specification repeated the original error, instructing to 'Replace the point load of 5 kN at (1,0.25) by a uniform traction t on the entire right edge x = 1'.
